name: Polymarket
description: Blockchain-based prediction market using USDC stablecoin for real-money wagering on event outcomes. Aggregates distributed knowledge about geopolitical, economic, and sports outcomes. One of the largest active prediction markets by volume.
evaluation_method: Market price as probability, settlement on resolved outcomes
notes: Subject to geographic restrictions. Uses USDC stablecoin. Blockchain-based for transparency and trustless settlement.
